About this blog:
---
Hi! I'm Khadija, an Information Systems and Data Science student at GW with a minor in Economics. I like using data and technology to figure out why things work the way they do, whether that's modeling solar energy growth, analyzing markets, or figuring out how errors move through a quantum circuit.

This started as my first data science blog and has turned into a place where I keep the projects, research, and random questions I get curious enough to investigate.
